questions.question: A 2D array represents a 3x3 tic-tac-toe board. How would you access the centre square?
questions.correctAnswer: The centre square is at row 1, column 1: board[1][1]
questions.explanation: Answer: The centre square is at row 1, column 1: board[1][1]

questions.question: Define a record called Car with fields for make (string), model (string), year (integer), and price (real).
questions.correctAnswer: TYPE Car make AS STRING model AS STRING year AS INTEGER price AS REAL ENDTYPE
questions.explanation: Answer: TYPE Car make AS STRING model AS STRING year AS INTEGER price AS REAL ENDTYPE
